subject: integration
name: Load from the site owner's record
summary: A switch, on or off, that lets a load follow the record the site's owner set on its name (an ENS contenthash, or a DNSLink value of a DNS name) and hands it to the source rows of its type. It runs and connects to nothing itself and checks nothing. The record may have been proven by the light client, or read from DNS, an installed name resolver or an Ethereum node that proves nothing, and the row does not tell them apart. Level 3, not 4: it accepts data nothing checks. Not private: the sources it hands the record to connect for it. Judged here by its publisher.
